target.title: feat(tui): opt-in persistence and agent visibility for `!`/`!!` local shell commands
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

TUI-local `!`-prefixed shell commands render a live local echo but are never persisted: closing the TUI loses them, session resume never shows them, and the agent cannot see what the operator ran or what it printed — even though the `BashExecutionMessage`/`excludeFromContext` data model and the LLM-context filtering for it already exist in `packages/agent-core` (previously unused by any production code path).

Split out of #103147 per review feedback there; that PR now carries only the rendering fixes.

## Why This Change Was Made

Operators often run a `!` command specifically to show the agent something (Claude Code's own `!` behaves this way). But local shell output can also be sensitive, so persistence and model visibility must be a deliberate choice, not a silent default:

- The session consent prompt now offers **No** / **Yes, local only** / **Yes, and share with the agent**. **Local only is the shipped, pre-existing behavior and stays the default expectation** — nothing is saved or shared unless the operator explicitly picks the share option.
- With sharing enabled, `!cmd` persists agent-visible (the agent sees it on its next turn) and `!!cmd` persists history-only (`excludeFromContext: true`, never reaches the model). Both semantics are stated in the consent prompt itself.

Implementation: an additive, hidden (`advertise: false`, `operator.admin`) `chat.injectBashExecution` gateway RPC modeled on `chat.inject`, implemented in both TUI backends (embedded calls the shared core directly in-process; gateway goes over the RPC). No live broadcast: the originating client already rendered its own local echo. History replay renders `bashExecution` entries on session resume.

Two defects found during review/testing are fixed here as well:

- A failed spawn emits both `error` and `close`; a shared settled-guard ensures one command persists at most once.
- Rows injected while an agent run is in flight now carry `appendMode: "side"` (like `chat.inject`'s assistant bookkeeping rows) so they do not steal the run's active leaf. Without this, persisting a `!` result mid-run tripped the embedded runner's session-file fence ("session file changed while embedded prompt lock was released") and killed the run. The run adopts side entries into the chain on its next append, so the agent still sees them next turn.

## User Impact

- Default behavior is unchanged: `!` commands stay local-only unless the operator opts into sharing at the consent prompt.
- With sharing enabled, `!` output survives session resume and is visible to the agent next turn; `!!` output survives resume but never reaches the model.
- Running a shared `!` command while the agent is mid-turn no longer kills the run with a session takeover error.

## Evidence

- `src/tui/tui-local-shell.test.ts` — 12 tests: consent options (local-only default persists nothing; share option persists), `!` vs `!!` `excludeFromContext` round-trip, no-scope/no-backend skips, persistence-failure surfacing, once-only persistence on error-then-close, plus the pre-existing output-cap/UTF-16/cwd guards.
- `src/gateway/server-methods/chat.inject-bash-execution.test.ts` — parentId chain preserved, `excludeFromContext` round-trip, **mid-run side-append regression test** (fence takeover repro), idle active-append, unresolved-identity failure.
- `src/tui/gateway-chat.test.ts`, `src/tui/embedded-backend.test.ts` — both backend implementations (RPC params/result shapes; embedded in-process delegation and failure surfacing).
- `src/gateway/server-methods-list.test.ts` — hidden method not advertised, handler dispatchable.
- Full `src/tui` suite green locally; protocol schema regenerated (`pnpm protocol:gen` / `protocol:gen:swift` — Swift models committed).
- Redacted PTY evidence of live `!` vs `!!` behavior: to follow in a comment.
